subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom. 

To hold water
solution:
The correct answer is **"To be valid and reasonable"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The meaning of the given idiom **"To hold water"** is **"To bear close inspection; to be valid"**
 
• Let's see an example-
 
 
• Her alibi just didn't hold water.
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct answer is **Option 1.**
